# Images described two different ways in the corpus.
#
# The same image file cannot honestly carry two different descriptions -- the
# pixels do not change between pages. When it does, the usual cause is alt text
# written from the adjacent sentence rather than from the image, which is the
# failure mode that dominated the 2026-08 screenshot audit.
#
# This list is a ratchet: it may shrink, never grow. It is currently EMPTY --
# all 20 conflicts found by the audit were reconciled. Keep it that way.
